name: Music Flyout
description:
A Fluent-style now-playing pill and flyout card for the top panel.

Controls any MPRIS player: album art, seek bar, shuffle/loop, scroll-wheel, click and hover actions, player switching, and a start-my-player-on-play option.

Optional extras:
* Install the 'cava' package for a real audio visualizer (otherwise animated bars are shown).
* The 'Playlists' card style can list your Spotify playlists. It needs a one-time login with your own Spotify developer app; it only reads your playlists and contacts Spotify only after you connect.
